name: make_v6
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
s=open("source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff",encoding="utf-8").read()
reps=[
(".br\n.sp 1v\n.ne 5v\n.ft B\n.ps 13\nReferences",
 ".br\n.sp 0.5v\n.ne 5v\n.ft B\n.ps 13\nReferences"),
(".sp 0.5v\n.sp 0.65v\n[1] Lawrence Hollom",
 ".sp 0.5v\n.sp 0.3v\n[1] Lawrence Hollom"),
(".sp 0.5v\n.sp 0.65v\nThe prior-art search",
 ".sp 0.5v\n.sp 0.3v\nThe prior-art search"),
("The prior-art search was bounded. It covered the supplied primary sources and a bounded later-literature search, not a full citation graph, and it does not establish worldwide absence.",
 "The prior-art search was bounded: it covered the supplied primary sources and a bounded later-literature search, not a full citation graph, and does not establish worldwide absence."),
("The proof is short and the method elementary, and the reflection device is old.",
 "The proof is short and elementary, and the reflection device is old."),
]
for a,b in reps:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a[:50]
    s=s.replace(a,b)
open("qa/tmp/v6.roff","w",encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("ok")
